text_block_list.text:
Vodka walked over, looking somewhat 
exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
*sigh*... Why did I have to go and dream 
something like that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
To think I'd have a dream where I'm 
surrounded by tons of plushies, giggling 
away—

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Could it be that deep down in your 
subconscious, you actually yearn for a 
cute room like that?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Me? Longing for a cute room?

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Haaah... Waking up felt awful, and I feel 
super exhausted somehow...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll keep training light today...
